turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling after the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: A bit sore, but okay lah. Still sleepy one.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: That's expected. On a scale of 0 to 10, how would you rate your pain right now?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Eh, maybe 4 or 5. My tummy is aching a bit, and I feel some burning from the tubes.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Understood. Are you feeling nauseous or have you vomited at all since waking up?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No vomiting, but my stomach feels a bit uneasy. Like I might throw up if I move too much.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Okay, we can give you something for that. How’s your breathing? Any shortness of breath or discomfort?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Breathing is fine, but my throat is a bit sore from the tube, I think.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: That can happen with the breathing tube. Do you remember anything from the operation itself?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I don’t remember anything. I just fell asleep and then woke up here.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good. We’ll keep an eye on your blood pressure and overall condition. You have a history of hypertension and high cholesterol, so we’ll monitor those as well.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Okay, thank you. I hope I can go home soon.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: We’ll see how you progress. For now, rest and let the nurses know if you need anything.
